study_role: new group-held-out evaluation on previously unevaluated original training groups; not an independent dataset replication
eligible_source_pool: primary rows whose connected group was assigned to the original train partition; original development, method-validation, and final groups are excluded because their attack outcomes were inspected

test_partition.assignment: new deterministic seed and group-atomic allocation from the eligible source pool only
test_partition.stratification: balance label counts and mixed-label exact-HTML groups; record actual row/group totals

remaining_pool_partition.assignment: deterministic group allocation among non-test eligible groups

detectors.logistic_regression: same registered L2 logistic family and train-only standardization as original PoC; refit on new train groups; choose fixed grid by development average precision
detectors.gradient_boosting: same registered shallow gradient boosting family as original PoC; refit on new train groups; choose fixed grid by development average precision
detectors.operating_point: target 2% empirical development benign FPR, report achieved FPR and Wilson interval; state development-informed history of the original 2% amendment

features: same 12 frozen source-derived features and extractor; no registry changes
cue_family_assignment: same deterministic family hash rule and family registry, with a new versioned seed fixed before test access

cue_arms.F_first: first factual feature in the preassigned family under frozen registry order, without using model relevance
cue_arms.R_random: uniform draw from factual mutable same-family cues excluding the model-selected feature; independently seeded per development start before searches; if no distinct alternative exists, exclude from the primary M-versus-R matched set and count against coverage
cue_arms.M_model: distinct eligible factual same-family feature with largest positive reduction in frozen model phishing score when replaced by train-only median/mode; registry-order tie break

primary_estimand: paired row-weighted M_model minus R_random binary-flip risk difference at one changed coordinate and five total queries, separately for each detector, among initially detected test phishing starts with an eligible M cue and at least one distinct factual mutable same-family random alternative
secondary_estimand: paired M_model minus F_first difference on the same rows; report selector collisions and each selector's coverage

search.endpoint: abstract feature-vector binary prediction flip; no URL/HTML dependency feasibility claim
search.attacker_feedback: cue identity and binary verdicts only; no scores, gradients, coefficients, or thresholds

inference.unit: connected group; retain all paired rows within sampled group
inference.interval: two-sided 97.5% percentile group bootstrap for two primary M_model-minus-R_random detector contrasts (Bonferroni familywise 5%)
inference.seed: fixed, documented before final evaluation; separate deterministic stream per detector
inference.secondary_and_sensitivity: clearly labeled exploratory; report all 5/10/20/40 query cells without promoting a favorable cell to confirmatory

feasibility_gate.projection_source: development-only pilot; must simulate the random selector and paired M-R comparison, not reuse the old M-S projection
feasibility_gate.failure_action: Current development pilot fails the minimum-group and projected-precision gate. Do not open test outcomes. A versioned development-only amendment is required before any test evaluation.

guardrails: The new test consists only of original train groups that had no prior attack outcomes; retrain both detectors excluding every new test group.
Do not use old development, method-validation, or final groups in this confirmatory test because their attack outcomes were inspected.
The original final split and its results remain frozen and unchanged.
Freeze split membership, model-selection rule, thresholds, cue rules, random seed, budget, analysis, and artifact hashes before any new test label/prediction/attack outcome is inspected.
Do not call this a fully independent replication: same dataset, feature work, and prior development decisions remain shared.
Do not claim valid webpage edits, operational evasion, explanation usefulness, or human impact.
unresolved_before_freeze: The development-only pilot produced only 68 and 70 eligible connected groups, below the planned 200-group and 8-point precision gates; do not evaluate the current test partition under this protocol.
Revise the split fractions or narrow/redefine the study using development-only evidence; any revised protocol and test membership must be frozen before test outcomes are accessed.
Verify current supervisor ethics declaration covers the added comparison and local processing.
